Name: Asters Festival Kotatsu
Author: Asterisk555
TagLine: Adds kotatsu tables and cushions with different colour options
Description:
_Description:_

*   Adds kotatsu furniture with matching cushions

*   There are two versions, the DGA version adds the items as furniture you can buy from festival shops. The CP version is mobile compatible and give you the choice to replace a selection of chairs, and either the Winter Star Tree or the Yellow Couch. __And your newly retextured tree or couch will work like a table!__
_Quick start for [DGA] version_

1.  Download this mod and it's requirements. For the DGA version you need [DGA](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365)

2.  Extract the main file of this mod and it's required mods into your mods folder (if you are confused check out [this guide](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started) )

3.  Buy the furniture at seasonal shops, there'll be a different design at each of the festivals
_Notes for [CP] version__Quick start [CP] mobile compatible version:_

1.  For the CP (mobile compatible) version you need version   1.19 of [CP](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915)  or higher

2.  Extract this mod and it's required mods into your mods folder (if you are confused check out [this guide](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started) )

3.  Launch and then close the game so a config.json is created (or just launch the game if you are using [GMCM](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098) )

4.  Select which furniture you want, available options can be found in the assets folder you just need to copy the file name into your config

5.  (If you are a PC user you will also need to change the config so mobile user is false)

6.  The mod should be ready to play! You can check the references folder for config options
_Config options_
The cushions can replace either a stool or chairs. If you want to be able to turn the cushions to see different views pick a chair, but a bunch of the cushions only have one view so it makes more sense to replace the stool.

_Compatibility_
CP version might not work if you have other mods that change the same furniture you choose to have replaced. One workaround is to add a "z" to the start of this mod folder's name, another is to add that other mod as a false dependency in the manifest.json___Known bugs_

*   CP version: Cat isn't animated. This isn't a bug, I didn't do this for the CP version because if you're on mobile you'll probably want to avoid lag and CP animations adds lag.[/spoiler]
_Notes for [CF] version_

*   Thanks to squidorama for the conversion!

*   There are the 3 options for the Ice Kotatsu. One animated, one static with cat, and one static with no cat.

*   The cushions are available as rugs and chairs. The rugs are named with something like "Ice Cushion" and the chair counterpart would be "Ice Cushion Chair".

*   I personally don't use CF so unfortunately won't be able to answer questions about how to use it[/spoiler]
_Tips and tricks_

*   The yellow and blue Luau kotatsu is made to match a bunch of yellow recolors based on [Penny's NPC furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10327), and also includes some oak recolors that would match the red Winter Star kotatsu quite well.

*   The Flower Festival kotatsu is based on Lumisteria's [[CF] Spring Furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8571) which also has a [DGA conversion](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9733)
_Credits_

*   The Flower Festival kotatsu is based on Lumisteria's [[CF] Spring Furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8571) which also has a [DGA conversion](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9733) made by Elizabeth who has helped me a lot with making DGA mods and has wrote a [tutorial for making DGA furniture](https://stardewmodding.wiki/wiki/Tutorial:_Creating_Custom_Furniture_With_DGA) .

*   [Fruitipebbles](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/106750543?tab=user+files)  for the patterns I used as backgrounds in the preview images
_Fun things
_I have a [discord server](https://discord.gg/YPEN5fg7qG) now! Where I'll post wip art and you can make suggestions for new mods, ask for help, or just chat and show off your farm.  I also do [art and other comissions](https://ko-fi.com/asteriskart/gallery).

Downloads.Description: @DGAFurniture Lets you buy the kotatsu and cushions at festival shops. Kotatsu work like tables and cushions work like rugs.

@CP Requires content patcher and is mobile and PC compatible. Lets you choose which existing vanilla furniture to replace.

Update: The beds were glitching in mobile so I changed it so it's no longer the beds that get replaced
